description: Set up and manage iOS WebDriverAgent (WDA), needed for structured iOS tap/type/snapshot; start with action:"setup": it reuses a running WDA, else builds (if no build exists) and starts it as one consent-gated job (poll qa_job_status, then qa_wda attach). build/start are consent-gated; attach takes an external webDriverAgentUrl; status/doctor/diagnose/logs/tune inspect.

action.description: build: background job, reuses a build unless rebuild:true. start: waits up to 45 s, then status:"starting" (poll qa_wait for:"wda_ready").

allowNonLoopback.description: Required to use a non-loopback external WDA URL.

rebuild.description: build/setup: run build-for-testing even when a previous build (.xctestrun) exists.

webDriverAgentUrl.description: Default: this session's WDA (attached, or the last start / reuse), else ios.wda.url (http://127.0.0.1:8100). Non-loopback needs allowNonLoopback + consent.

name: qa_wda
title: iOS WebDriverAgent setup and control
